Role: Chief Marketing Officer
Industry: E-Learning
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: HubSpot is a great tool for SMBs looking to scale up to serving an enterprise segment. The integration of marketing, sales and customer success in one place is very useful. Everyone knows about HubSpot from their inbound marketing, and I feel they provide great value even to those who have not purchased their products.
Cons: CRM is a bit clunky, and there is a learning curve, even for some basic features. You need to upgrade to a higher plan to really use it well, and the pricing structure is quite complicated.
Comments: Good tool to get marketing and sales teams on the same page. HubSpot needs to work on its pricing to make it easier to understand.
Reasons for choosing: Ease of use and customizable pricing options
Alternatives considered: Pipedrive|Salesforce Sales Cloud

Role: Director
Industry: E-Learning
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The thing I like most about Hubspot is the teams feature allowing me to add users to my business CRM.
Cons: The thing I liked least about the CRM was that I had to use Zapier to link to other platforms that we use. But overall it worked.
Comments: Overall I am pleased with HubSpot. I haven't had to call in for tech support, but I did use the tech support chat option on their website and it was very helpful.
Reasons for choosing: We chose Hubspot over other CRM's because it offers the teams feature and the price point was reasonable.

Role: CTO & co-founder
Industry: Financial Services
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: It has a lot of nice features + it's customisable + it works (no obvious bugs) + HubSpot provides support to their customers (even small like us) + they have nice startup discounts for the 1st and 2nd year + it's a well know tool. So overall it has a lot of pros.
Cons: HubSpot is not perfect, we had to do many compromises, because certain (even pretty basic) things don't work like we expect(ed) them to work. In many cases this affects productivity and often give a filling that we are using hummer where screwdriver in needed.
Comments: It goes in ups and downs. Though sales team seems to be more happy with it than the CTO.
Reasons for choosing: More straight forward tool.
Reasons for switching: We wanted to combine serval tools, which we had to use in addition to the old CRM in one to improve experience for our sales team.
Switched from: [truncated]

Role: ライター
Industry: Writing and Editing
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: 電話内容やメール内容、対面での打ち合わせ内容など、顧客に紐づくあらゆる過去応対データをこの一つに集約化できる。また、ールフォームからの問い合わせや申込など、放置されやすい見込顧客の管理とアフターフォローの自動化ができる点がいいと思う。
Cons: 現在の機能については申し分ないが、ZoomなどのWEB会議ツールとの連携ができると良い。Zoomの録画データを自動的にHubSpotCRM側に転送できるシステムがあると、顧客との応対データの集約化をより実現できるのではと思う。
Comments: HubSpotCRMは、顧客管理に必要な機能が充実しており、使いやすいインターフェースが特徴的な優れたツールだと思います。顧客とのコミュニケーション履歴を一元管理できることで、ビジネスプロセスの効率化や顧客サービスの向上につながる。。ただ、機能が多く初めて使用する人には少し複雑に感じるかもしれません。また、最新の機能を使うためには追加料金が必要な場合があるため、予算の面で注意が必要です。

Cons: They allow limited customization in Free Plan. I think cost little bit high .
Comments: HubSpot CRM is very user friendly interface . They connects easily with other platforms.

Possui ampla gama de possibilidades de integração com outras ferramentas, uma boa loja de aplicativos e customização do fluxo de vendas e insights.
Cons: Se você busca um CRM completo, que vai te entregar um bom desempenho ponta-a-ponta, não vejo esta ferramenta como a melhor opção, visto que, embora seja muito bem estruturada para o setor de vendas e pré-vendas, ainda peca nas áreas de marketing e pós-venda.

Posso dizer que o melhor desempenho foi apresentado no segundo caso, conseguimos gerar análises e [truncated]

Role: Business Development Specialist
Industry: Financial Services

Cons: Very slight learning curve, especially if you've used a crm in the past. But, this is the case with most crm software
Comments: Pipedrive provides a great solution for keeping track of prospects, where they are in the sales process, how much revenue has been won/lost, and key metrics for focusing efforts in the most worthy activities. It's so intuitive and sleek design. Has everything you need for your sales efforts
Reasons for choosing: I chose it because it offered the best value out of all the other alternatives I was considering in terms of usability, customizability, integrations, tracking metrics
Alternatives considered: Dynamics 365|Salesforce Sales Cloud
